help.settlementTypes: Settlement types are the size tiers of your settlements (e.g. Hamlet → City), ordered smallest to largest. A location's settlement type can gate which goods are available and cap the largest coin denomination traded locally.
help.locationTemplates: Location templates are reusable blueprints for the establishments players visit — inns, merchants, banks. Configure a template once here, then place instances of it on any settlement scene; instance changes can later be overridden or reset back to the template.
help.currencyMode: Choose how currency is tracked. Loose: untracked — purchase totals are whispered to the GM and buyer to record manually. Attribute: a number stored on the actor sheet. Item: a world item document carried in inventory. The fields below depend on this choice.
help.currencyModeLoose: Untracked — purchase totals are whispered to the GM and buyer to record manually.
help.currencyModeAttribute: A number stored on the actor sheet. Each currency must have a dot-notation attribute path configured.
help.currencyModeItem: A world item document carried in inventory. Each currency must be linked to a specific item.
help.currencyList: Define each denomination and its exchange rate relative to the standard (1:1) currency. Order them however you like — drag the handle to reorder. The standard currency is the base all prices are converted through.
help.itemGlobal: Tell the module how to read names and prices from this game system's item documents, using dot-notation paths. Set these once so merchants can import items and price them correctly.
help.itemTypes: Map this system's item types so merchants can group their inventory and apply per-type buy/sell rules in purchasing profiles.
help.bankExchange: Controls whether this bank converts between currencies and the percentage fee charged on each exchange.
help.bankDeposits: Configure player deposits: an optional fee taken when depositing, a minimum lock-in period before penalty-free withdrawal, and an early-withdrawal penalty. A Global bank shares one deposit ledger across every scene, so players can deposit and withdraw at any of its branches.
help.merchantInventory: Define the stock this merchant starts with and how it restocks over time. Availability and stock formulas can vary by settlement size. Drag items from the sidebar onto the drop zone to add them.
help.merchantPurchasing: Set how this merchant buys items from players: the buy rate (percent of value paid) and how buyback pricing works, optionally overridden per item type.
help.merchantSettlementSize: Minimum settlement size this item will appear in stock for merchants using this template.
help.merchantAvailability: Chance that this item will be present in a merchant, re-checked each restock period.
help.merchantStockFormula: Dice/number formula rolled to set quantity when in stock (e.g. 2d6). Leave blank for infinite stock.
help.importExport: Export selected configuration sections to a JSON file to back them up or share between worlds, or import a previously exported file. Importing overwrites the selected sections in this world.

importExport.sectionFailed: Failed to import {section} — the data may be invalid.

currency.isStandardHint: The standard currency is the base for all exchange rates (always 1:1). Only one currency should be standard.
currency.exchangeRateHelp: Enter as A:B — where A of the STANDARD currency equals B of THIS currency.
currency.attributePathHint: Dot-notation path on the actor data model (e.g. system.currency.gp).
currency.itemHint: Search and select the item document that represents this currency.
currency.quantityPathHint: Leave blank to use system.quantity. Set to e.g. system.quantity.value for systems that store quantity as a nested object.
